question: Under what condition should a teacher confer the teaching for lasting benefit?
premises: The teacher must examine the recipient thoroughly.
This examination should always be done.
inference: Only after thorough examination should the teacher give, thereby granting long-lasting benefit.
uncertainties: The fused token dadyāccirajīvitam may mean give long life or give for long life.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one who gives to him grants long life.
